description: Jordan is holding the key to their late grandmother's house and must decide what to do with her inherited upright piano, including who will host it, where it will stand, and what preparation it needs before the family starts using it.

shared_context.S1: Their late grandmother's empty house contains her upright piano, which the family wants to keep in use rather than discard.
shared_context.S2: Jordan has the house key and is making the final plan for the piano.
shared_context.S3: The piano should have one primary family home, and the family wants relatives to be able to visit and play it by arrangement.
shared_context.S4: As a normal family check-in before making a final call, Jordan goes around the group and asks each person what they can take on and what would make the plan workable; each person states their answer directly, and Jordan records the answers before finalizing.

PF1.text: Riley has a clear 150-centimeter wall in the north side of Riley's living room, and Riley is willing to host the piano there; the piano is 145 centimeters wide.

PF2.text: A piano technician, Nina Patel, inspected the instrument and recommended tuning it before anyone plays it and keeping the room between 45 and 55 percent humidity; Nina's recommendation has not reached the group yet.

acceptance_conditions: Riley must be selected as the piano's primary host.
The piano must be placed on the north wall of Riley's living room, using the clear 150-centimeter wall that fits the 145-centimeter piano.
The piano must be tuned before anyone plays it.
The room must be kept between exactly 45 and 55 percent humidity.
A commitment must confirm that Riley will host the piano.
A commitment must arrange tuning before the first playing session.
The technician's recommendation must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C2: decisions['placement'] in ['North wall of Riley\'s living room', 'North-side wall of Riley\'s living room', 'North side wall of Riley\'s living room', 'North side of Riley\'s living room, along the 150-centimeter wall', 'North side of Riley\'s living room, along the clear 150-centimeter wall', 'North wall of Riley\'s living room (150-centimeter wall, piano is 145 centimeters)', 'North wall of Riley\'s living room (150 cm available wall space, piano is 145 cm)', 'North-side wall of Riley\'s living room (150 cm available wall, 145 cm piano width)', 'North side wall of Riley\'s living room (150 cm available wall, 145 cm piano width)', 'North side of Riley\'s living room, along the 150-centimeter wall', 'North side of Riley\'s living room, along the clear 150-centimeter wall', 'North side of Riley\'s living room, along the 150-centimeter wall (piano is 145 centimeters wide)', 'North side of Riley\'s living room, along the clear 150-centimeter wall (piano is 145 centimeters wide)']
content_checks.C5: any((c['type'] == 'hosting' or c['type'] == 'access' or c['type'] == 'family_access') and c['target'] == 'Riley' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'tuning' or c['type'] == 'tuning_coordination' or c['type'] == 'tune_before_playing' or c['type'] == 'maintenance_coordination' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Riley's willingness and the 150-centimeter north wall that fits the 145-centimeter piano change the host to Riley, the placement to Riley's north living-room wall, and the required hosting commitment.
Nina Patel's recommendation changes the preparation from an unspecified plan to tuning before playing and an exact 45-to-55-percent humidity range, while supplying the required cited justification.
